           floor_level, floor_label, area_sqm, capacity, is_bookable,
           bim_model_id, bim_element_id, geometry, attributes)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9::float8::numeric,

                coalesce($14, '{}'::jsonb), coalesce($15, '{}'::jsonb))
